what_a_pass_means: This manifest records what was verified, when, and by which command. A passing test_baseline_manifest means the RECORD is well-formed and tracks the live engine version. It does not re-run any of the evidence below, and it does not mean the product is correct.
rename_reason: The old name asserted that the contents described engine v63. They no longer did: the file sat at engine_version 63 while the live engine reached 75, so test_manifest_tracks_the_live_engine_baseline failed for twelve versions (F6). A baseline that has to be renamed every engine bump will not be, so it is now version-neutral and carries the version as data.

toolchain.note: Measured in the nesnative dev container on 2026-08-06. These differ from the 2026-07-10 capture, which ran on a different host (python 3.13.5, node 20.19.2, npm 9.2.0) -- recorded so a future mismatch is read as 'different machine', not 'regression'.

builder_regression.notes: 113 suites, 0 failures, exit 0 — re-run in full at v82, 7m51s. The three suites beyond v78's 110 arrived with the port-forward: render-p1-oam-cursor.mjs (#37, v80), enemy-bump.mjs (#30, v81) and render-dialogue-noflash.mjs (#31, v82). No listener survived anywhere in the allocated range 18800-19138 afterwards and `git status` was empty. Earlier the same day: 110 suites at v78 in 8m26s and 111 at v80 in 7m25s, both clean.

engine_snapshot.notes: Confirms the v82 snapshot matches HEAD, 41 of 41 files read back FROM HEAD (not merely present on disk — direction 3, added after F21). v80/v81/v82 are this branch's ports of main's v76/v77/v78; the numbers diverge and tools/builder-tests/lib/snapshot-collisions.mjs asserts exactly which, including that 80-82 are local-only and main may still claim them.

native_unittest.notes: Re-run at v82: 224 passed, 161 skipped, 195 subtests passed, 0 failures and 0 errors. PySide6 is absent in this container, so the Qt UI layer is untested here, NOT passing — do not read the pass count as coverage.
known_gaps: F3 is fixed: no collection errors and no absent-dependency failures remain; the modules that need Qt now skip. The 161 skips are the UI layer standing down.
The Qt UI suite has never been run anywhere, because no dev-container image in this repository's history installs Qt. See .devcontainer/README.md.

golden_rom_sha1.note: Not a stale copy. These same three values are asserted live by tools/builder-tests/run-all.mjs (GOLDEN_STOCK, GOLDEN_TEMPLATE) and tools/builder-tests/_rom-equiv.mjs (EXPECT), which run in the builder suite recorded above. They therefore hold at engine v82. stock and no_modules_template have not moved through the port-forward at all — projects without an HP HUD or dialogue still build byte-for-byte. everything_on moved twice: 0aed6e95 -> 972cb215 at v80 (#37's heart-loop change) and -> e86a91b8 at v82 (#31's dialogue banner writer). Both are the values main measured independently for the same changes, which is a check on the ports rather than a restatement of them. That history lives in this note and not in keys of its own: test_golden_hashes_are_explicit requires every value here to be a bare sha1, and it caught the attempt.

manual_fceux_v63.carried_forward_note: Preserved verbatim from the 2026-07-10 capture. It is evidence about v63 and has NOT been repeated at v75. Twelve engine versions have landed since; three of the seven starter ROMs are known to have changed in that range (see docs/handoffs/2026-08-06-starter-fixture-rebaseline.md). Treat this as history, not as current attended coverage.
manual_fceux_v63.attestation: The product owner reports that the C and ASM files passed all relevant attended tests checked at the time.
manual_fceux_v63.limitations: The earlier manual run did not leave a case-by-case command, input-sequence, screenshot, or observation manifest. Current automated v63 coverage therefore remains the reproducible evidence; the attestation closes the attended gate without fabricating missing observations.
